cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -18
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://venice.ai/sign-up",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=60000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(4000)
    pg.fill('input[name="emailAddress"]',f"vt{int(time.time())}@sinaja.cyou")
    pg.fill('input[name="password"]',"Str0ng!Pass123")
    pg.click("text=Continue")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(9000)
    for f in pg.frames:
        if "challenges.cloudflare.com" in f.url:
            try:
                box=f.locator("body")
                print("frame text:",repr(f.inner_text("body")[:150]))
                box.click(timeout=6000); print("diklik di frame")
            except Exception as e: print("klik:",type(e).__name__)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(9000)
    print("token:",pg.evaluate("(document.querySelector('[name=cf-turnstile-response]')||{}).value||''").__len__())
    print("isi halaman:",pg.inner_text("body")[:200].replace("\n"," | "))
    b.close()
